Not even the half-step Heaven Immortal could stand his single blow.
If they charged at him right now, they would most likely end up dead.
In that case, they had no more reason to look down on Jiang Chen anymore.
“Never thought that there is such a rare genius in One-Line-Sky.
Jiang Chen, I have to admit that you are truly a genius of the geniuses.
If it was before, I would’ve probably tried all my best to invite you into Profound Sun Sect, but too bad, you have chosen the wrong path.”
Said Luo Xiang.
What he said was the truth.
When a genius like Jiang Chen appear in this world, all four major powers would’ve fought for him.
Having a genius with great future was really important to a sect.
Unfortunately, the relationship between Jiang Chen and the Profound Sun Sect had already deteriorated.
There was no more chance of recovering it.
Since he was an enemy now, they must destroy him at all cost to prevent him from growing.
Otherwise, they would leave behind future troubles and threats.
“I’ll try him out.”
An incomparably cold voice sounded from Luo Xiang’s side.
This man was called Wang Ying, an inner sect disciple of the sect.
He had the same cultivation as Luo Xiang, early Heaven Immortal realm.
This man didn’t like to speak much, but he had high cultivation and special cultivation technique.
The energy that was exuded from his body was cold and chilly.
Although it wasn’t comparable to Yan Chenyu’s Nine Yin Divine Physique, he must have a very powerful destructive force.
He was probably more powerful than Luo Xiang in a real battle.
“Little Chen, can you handle him?”
Han Yan, who was currently in the Ancestral Dragon Pagoda right now asked concernedly.
After all, Jiang Chen’s opponent was an early Heaven Immortal expert.
The gap between them was just too great.
“No worries.”
Said Jiang Chen casually.
Someone like Wang Ying was no doubt more powerful than Yan Dongliu and Huang Ying.
Although he could kill Huang Ying in his dragon form, it didn’t mean that he could kill Wang Ying.
Of course, if he used all of the techniques he had, he might be able to kill Wang Ying, but he had just arrived One-Line-Sky and had to keep his trump card a secret.
He didn’t want to expose them yet.
However, if the cultivation technique that Wang Ying practiced was of cold attribute, Jiang Chen certainly had the ability to kill him.
His flames was the natural enemy of any cold attribute technique.
Compared to an Earth Immortal expert, the greatest advantage that a Heaven Immortal had was the flying ability.
However, Wang Ying didn’t maximize this advantage because he thought that it was unnecessary while fighting Jiang Chen.
*Pu Chi!*
Wang Ying casted his cultivation law and strode forward.
The air around him produced a shrill sound.
Layers of white cold fog drifted around him, causing the surrounding temperature to drop all of a sudden.
“Senior Brother Wang’s Cold Frost Technique has already reached such a powerful extent.
His Qi alone causes me to shiver involuntarily.”
“That’s right.
Although Senior Brother Wang has been a silent and cold person, his cultivation isn’t any weaker than senior brother Lou.
In a one-to-one fight, I don’t think that Senior Brother Luo could rival him.”
“Do you all think that this Jiang Chen is an opponent of Senior Brother Wang?”
“You think too much.
There is a huge difference between an Earth Immortal and Heaven Immortal.
He would never stand a chance against a Heaven Immortal opponent no matter how powerful he is.”
The disciples of Profound Sun Sect was very confident in Wang Ying.
Wang Ying came to the opposite side of Jiang Chen.
Because of his incomparably cold Qi, it gave those who were around them a freezing sensation.
Without saying a word, ice started to condense between his palms.
*Ka Ka...*
The ice grew larger and larger.
It was a cold and solid ice with destructive and freezing ability.
“Cold Ice Palm.”
Wang Ying bellowed in a low tone, pushing both of his palms forward.
A giant Cold Ice Palm Seal was struck out.
This icy palm could almost froze any void that it passed.
It had locked on Jiang Chen, eliminating all of his chances to escape.
In the blink of an eye, it reached Jiang Chen.
Jiang Chen’s expression turned grim.
This attack was indeed more powerful than Yan Dongliu’s and Huang Ying’s, especially because his technique was of cold attribute.
It had a natural effect of suppressing one’s opponent, which made it incomparable to any ordinary technique.
However, it didn’t concern Jiang Chen.
With his dragon form, his combat power was at its peak.
Jiang Chen pointed his finger like a sword, shooting out a fiery light to Wang Ying’s Cold Ice Palm.
It was the Profound Nine Solar Finger!
At this current moment, using the Profound Nine Solar Finger was as easy as moving his finger.
With just a casual point of his finger, a Profound Nine Solar Finger was struck out.
After hearing a bang sound, a large golden finger covered with steaming flames emerged.
The flames was the fusion of True Dragon Fire and true Lightning Fire, it could incinerate everything in the Heaven and Earth.
The Cold Ice Palm still seemed very scary, however, there was a huge difference between the cold attribute and the attribute of the Lightning Flame.
Even before both of their attacks collided, the Cold Ice Palm was already affected by the heat and began to melt.
*Hong Long...*
The terrifying Profound Nine Solar Finger collided hard with the Cold Ice Palm, creating a temporary dazzle in the sky.
The night sky was torn apart, making the scene seem like daytime.
The Cold Ice Palm was pulverized by the Profound Nine Solar Finger completely and was turned into steam.

The essence of the Cold Ice Palm laid on the icy cold Qi that originated from a cold attribute cultivation technique, however, such an attack lost its function and became vulnerable of being pulverized after its foundation was incinerated by the Lightning Flame.
“What?”
Wang Ying couldn’t help but exclaim under this circumstance.
Not just him, Luo Xiang who was behind him also widened his eyes.
They couldn’t believe this was real.
The early Heaven Immortal Wang Ying was widely recognized as a powerful expert, one of the promising inner sect disciple of the sect.
But now, he wasn’t even a match for Jiang Chen who seemed excessively powerful.
“Little Chen, don’t delay it anymore.
This is the territory of the Profound Sun Sect.
It won’t be in our favor if we attracted the true experts here.” Warned Han Yan.
“Alright.”
Jiang Chen nodded and drew out the Heavenly Saint Sword.
Then, he turned into a light ray, rushing forward.
His target wasn’t Wang Ying nor Luo Xiang, but those other outer sect disciples.
He understood the purpose of this trip very much, which was to create a big commotion by killing people, a commotion that could shake the entire One-Line-Sky and let Skycloud Pavilion know about him.
So that it would create an advantage for him in the future.
Therefore, it wasn’t important for him to kill Luo Xiang or Wang Ying.
What was more important was to kill these people, to send blows to Profound Sun Sect.
“Argh...” “Argh...”
Several wails were heard at the same time.
In just a few blinks, several outer sect disciples died under Jiang Chen’s sword.
Luo Xiang and Wang Ying were shocked until they were woken by the screams.
“Son of a b*tch!
Stop!”
Luo Xiang raged and lunged at Jiang Chen.
It was no different than letting a tiger into a flock of sheep.
To the outer sect disciples of Profound Sun Sect, it was a devastating disaster.
Wang Ying joined him.
Their objective was very simple - Jiang Chen.
These two Heaven Immortals could move at incomparably quick speed as they could control the air current around.
As such, it was very easy for them to besiege Jiang Chen.
However, itwasn’t as simple as they thought.
A brilliant fiery wings sprouted out of Jiang Chen’s back.
With a flutter of the wings, he moved faster compared to the two Heaven Immortals.
Plus, Jiang Chen’s strange movement skill made him an untraceable and unpredictable.
None of them could follow his tracks.
“Argh...” “Argh...” “Argh...”
Wails were continued to be heard as Jiang Chen flashed across the area, totally ignoring a direct confrontation with Luo Xiang and Wang Ying.
He didn’t stop killing those outer sect disciples who were now fleeing for their lives and shouting like crazy.
They were scared to death.
It was too terrifying.
They had never seen such a scary figure who looked like a devil king that killed unblinkingly.
“Dammit!”
Luo Xiang had an impulse to cough up blood while watching his juniors dying tragically one after another in Jiang Chen’s hands.
In another few blinks of time, a dozen more were dead.
However, they still couldn’t get ahold of Jiang Chen’s tracks, which was a great irony to them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1113 - Leave after the Kill
paragraphs: 4/14 chapters!

Wails were heard incessantly. After killing a dozen outer sect disciples of Profound Sun Sect, he stopped the massacre. The remaining outer sect disciples were fleeing in all directions for their lives. His objective had been met after killing this much people.
“Wang Ying, we will besiege him from the front and back. We have to capture him today.”

Luo Xiang’s eyes had already turned red. By controlling the airflow around him, he flew skywards with a swoosh. Wang Ying also flew up to the sky. Since they couldn’t catch Jiang Chen on the ground, then they should catch him in the sky.
*Hong Long...*
Both of them were holding Immortal Weapons, sending out extremely strong and fierce attack at their target - Jiang Chen.

Seeing what happened, Jiang Chen revealed a hint of a cold smile. He knew that killing Luo Xiang and Wang Ying would require specific means, however, it was also virtually impossible for these two opponents to harm him. In the aspect of speed alone, he certainly has the upper hand.

The Heaven Saint Sword rippled, slashing out countless rays of sword light at Luo Xiang and Wang Ying’s attack. At the same time, his Flaming Wings fluttered and rose to the sky, but instead of fleeing away, he went towards the ore mine.
“What?”

Luo Xiang and Wang Ying exclaimed once more, their eyes widened. They felt a violent twitch in their hearts when Jiang Chen soared up to the air abruptly. How could an Earth Immortal fly? What kind of joke was this? How could that be possible?
“Not good, he’s entering the ore mine.”

Luo Xiang regained his senses from the shock very quickly. There was no more time to ponder about how Jiang Chen was able to fly now. As this intruder had locked onto the ore mine, they had to stop him immediately. Otherwise, their sect would surely suffer a massive loss.

Both of them rushed towards the ore mine like a mad man. They had witnessed the destructive force of Jiang Chen. If this intruder was allowed to wreck havoc inside the ore mine, the entire hill would most likely be destroyed. That was a loss which two of them couldn’t bear.

Jiang Chen flew into the mine. The interior wasn’t a small one. It was equivalent to the size of an average square. Many cultivators were trying hard to mine the Immortal Meta Stones. There were heaps of small-hill-like ores on the ground. Most of them were low grade Immortal Meta Stones, and some middle grade Immortal Meta Stones but there were no high grade Immortal Meta Stones. High grade Immortal Meta Stones could only be found in those high grade ore mines. As these ore mines had high importance to the sect, they would send true experts to guard the place.
“Little Chen, there are plenty of Immortal Meta Stones here.”

Han Yan yelled inside the Ancestral Dragon Pagoda. This was his first time seeing so many Immortal Meta Stones. There was no way that he wouldn’t be excited about it. Anyone who came from the Mortal World was basically broke. Han Yan naturally was one of them.
“It will be a waste not to grab them.”
Jiang Chen would never be polite with Profound Sun Sect. With a wave of his hand, gust of winds swept up the piled of Immortal Meta Stones into his Ancestral Dragon Pagoda.

Han Yan also didn’t show any politeness, he immediately took a handful of Immortal Meta Stones and began refining it. Refining these stones would bring great benefits to him, he would probably break through to the late Human Immortal realm after the refinement.
“Bastard, stop!”

A loud yell was heard from behind. Luo Xiang and Wang Ying were rushing inside. Looking at Jiang Chen’s actions, it instantly gave them the impulse to spurt out blood. This fortune belonged to the Profound Sun Sect. They knew very well how hard it took to dig out these Immortal Meta Stones. Therefore, how could they keep their composure upon seeing these hard-earned fortune being robbed away by Jiang Chen just like that?
*Swoosh!* *Swoosh!*
Both of them struck two rays of brilliant light at Jiang Chen with their Immortal Weapons. Those were waves of destructive energy.
“Humph!”

Jiang Chen harrumphed coldly and swiped the Heavenly Saint Sword. The Qi of the sword was domineering. The three attacks collided, creating powerful shockwave that spread in all direction, causing the entire ore mine to shake.

Luo Xiang and Wang Ying were even more annoyed after seeing what just happened. They could never use any attack skill in this ore mine. If the three of them use their full-fledge attack in this hill, this ore mine would certainly end up being destroyed. They couldn’t afford to let that happen.
*Hua La!*

Jiang Chen couldn’t care less about the ore mine. He made another wave, sweeping another pile of Immortal Meta Stones like a blue whale sucking in water. All the Immortal Meta Stones were instantly sucked into his Ancestral Dragon Pagoda.
*Puff!*

Seeing this kind of situation made Luo Xiang spurt out blood. He and Wang Ying were shouting like nuts, but there was nothing that they could do about it. Their speed was no match for Jiang Chen and they couldn’t use their attack skills here. All they could do was to stay suffocated.
“Get lost if you don’t want to die.”
Jiang Chen looked at those mine cultivators and clamored.
“Run, run!”

All the workers were running away from the work site. Most of them were held captive by Profound Sun Sect as slaves. So, they naturally wouldn’t miss this great chance of escaping this eternal miserable fate. As for the dragonman who came out of nowhere, it was none of their concern.
“Jiang Chen, what are you doing?”
Luo Xiang glared daggers at Jiang Chen who was hovering in the air
“It’s very simple, I want to destroy this entire ore mine.” Jiang Chen shrugged.
“You dare?” Luo Xiang demanded.
*Hong Long...*

Jiang Chen used his action to answer Luo Xiang’s question. The Heavenly Saint Sword swiped out a long dragon. It crashed into the crystal wall of the mine. No matter how solid this ore mine could be, it could never stand such a fierce attack from Jiang Chen. Immediately, a large hole was created. Lines of crack appeared from the other walls, implying that the hill would crumble at any time.
“Damn him! This bastard is a madman!”
Said Wang Ying depressingly. They had no idea that Jiang Chen would dare to do such a thing.
*Hong Long...*

Jiang Chen didn’t even pay attention to the two as his attention was solely focused on the ore mine now. Even if they combined their strength, they wouldn’t be able to stop him. This was his purpose of coming here today. First was to kill a few people and second was to destroy the ore mine, he would certainly become famous in One-Line-Sky tomorrow.

“This man moves too fast. We can’t even catch up to him. This ore mine is an enormous treasure. We can’t afford to bear the consequences of the destruction of this ore mine. Senior Brother Luo, don’t you have the signaling spirit talisman? Quickly inform the sect to send high-level experts here to deal with this Jiang Chen.” Said Wang Ying with a glum face.
“Alright.”

Luo Xiang finally thought of this signaling spirit talisman. He turned his palm and a golden spirit talisman appeared on it. After casting his divine sense into it, it turned into a ray of golden light and vanished.
“Not good, little Chen, they are calling for high-level reinforcements.”

Han Yan who was in the Ancestral Dragon Pagoda could see anything that was happening outside clearly. His face immediately revealed concern. One should know that this place was the territory of Profound Sun Sect. It wouldn’t be long for their experts to get over here. Even if Jiang Chen had powerful means, he was too weak and pathetic compared to the entire Profound Sun Sect.
*Hong Long...*

Jiang Chen naturally saw what just happened. His Heavenly Saint Sword rippled once more, swiping countless of dragon-shaped sword Qi out. Under such heavy bombardment, the ore mine couldn’t stand it anymore and crumbled into ruins.
“Let’s go.”

His Flaming Wings fluttered and zipped through the crumbling rocks and away from the scene. Luo Xiang and Wang Ying wanted to chase after him but were stopped by the fact that they couldn’t catch up to him. So they could only watch him flee. Their facial expression had already turned extremely unpleasant. The loss of losing an ore mine was too much for the sect. Plus, many outer disciples had been killed by Jiang Chen. The moment the sect investigated deeply into this matter, the two of them could never escape their responsibility.
At this time, a light flashed past from a distance. Then, an old man with fluttering clothes emerged. His face instantly turned angry when he saw the ruined ore mine below.
“What happened?”

The elder looked over at the two of them. Even without the signaling spirit talisman sent by Luo Xiang, the sect could still sense the commotion on this ore mine. As such, the elder had come here to check out the situation, but didn’t expect to see what he was seeing.

“Elder Xie, someone has raided our ore mine. He has killed more than a dozen outer sect disciples, robbed all of our Immortal Meta Stones and destroyed the mine. Two of us couldn’t stop him. That man has already gone that way.”
Seeing the arrival of the elder was like seeing a savior. Without delay, they told everything that happened just now to the elder and pointed to where Jiang Chen had left.
“He must be exceedingly audacious to mess up in our territory! This old man will shred him into a million pieces the moment this old man catches him.”
The elder snorted and widened his eyes, then turned into a ray of light, racing towards the direction where Jiang Chen had left.
“Senior Brother Luo, do you think Elder Xie can catch that brat? That brat is only an early Earth Immortal expert, but how can he have such a terrifying speed?”

Wang Ying still had some lingering fears. They had never seen such a terrifying Earth Immortal expert. They were totally helpless. It was imaginable how much this incident would affect the reputation of Profound Sun Sect if it was spread out. Their sect would probably become the laughing stock of everyone.

“Don’t worry. Elder Xie is a late Heaven Immortal expert. No matter how terrifying that Jiang Chen is, he will surely meet his death in front of Elder Xie. Furthermore, the speed of a late Heaven Immortal is extremely fast. Neither of us is a match to that kind of speed.”
Said Luo Xiang. He was pretty confident in Elder Xie’s capability.

Under the night sky, Jiang Chen was travelling at a swift speed. Every place he went would leave an afterimage of him. Today’s incident was going to be spread across the entire One-Line-Sky. At that time, his name would certainly cause a commotion amongst the people and major powers. There would only be two situations that would happen after that. Profound Sun Sect would definitely hunt him down. As for the Skycloud Pavilion, they would surely try their best to recruit a rare genius like him. Therefore, he had decided that once this news was spread out, he would head over to the Skycloud Pavilion and try to mix into them. Additionally, he had already shown his talent and potential, he was sure that he would be treasured and nurtured the moment he arrived at Skycloud Pavilion. This was his first step of getting closer to Tian Muyun and the most important step of all.
“Little Chen, today is really exhilarating. Ha-ha! Profound Sun Sect suffered a tremendous loss today. I assume that they are already jumping in anger right now.”
Han Yan laughed delightfully. After being humiliated by the people of Profound Sun Sect for so long, he hadn’t had the slightest sentiments for this sect.

Additionally, he had already shown his talent and potential, he was sure that he would be treasured and nurtured the moment he arrived at Skycloud Pavilion.
This was his first step of getting closer to Tian Muyun and the most important step of all.
“Little Chen, today is really exhilarating.
Ha-ha!
Profound Sun Sect suffered a tremendous loss today.
I assume that they are already jumping in anger right now.”
Han Yan laughed delightfully.
After being humiliated by the people of Profound Sun Sect for so long, he hadn’t had the slightest sentiments for this sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 1114 - The Divine Ancestral Dragon Pagoda
paragraphs: 5/14 chapters!
“Not good, someone’s coming. It’s fast.”

Han Yan’s facial expression changed all of a sudden. A powerful Qi was approaching them at high speed from behind. He could sense that the Qi was extremely strong, incomparable to Luo Xiang and Wang Ying.
“It should be the expert of Profound Sun Sect, judging from the Qi, he must be at least a late Heaven Immortal expert.”

Said Jiang Chen with a frown. With his current ability, he stood no chance against a late Heaven Immortal expert even if he expended all of his skills. After all, the gap between them was just too great.
*Swoosh!*
He casted the dragon wings without delay. With Dragon Wings pairing with Flaming Wings, his speed was increased by a big notch. He turned into a green smoke and vanished speedily.
From behind, Elder Xie who was about to catch up to his target changed his expression dramatically.
“Impossible. He’s merely an Earth Immortal. How can he move so fast?”

As a late Heaven Immortal expert, he understood the gap between Heaven Immortal and Earth Immortal too well. It was already astounding that an Earth Immortal expert had the ability to fly, but it was even more shocking and unprecedented when this Earth Immortal expert could fly at such speed as well.

Elder Xie was thinking of punishing the two leaders, Luo Xiang and Wang Ying when he returned, but after witnessing Jiang Chen’s speed, he perished such thoughts. With such a difference in speed, it was only logical that the two of them couldn’t capture Jiang Chen. They couldn’t be blamed for the incident.
“Humph! A puny Earth Immortal is trying to run away from this old man’s grip? It’s absolutely delusional.”

Elder Xie harrumphed coldly. The aircurrent around him churned. His speed was suddenly doubled. As a late Heaven Immortal expert, he naturally had much stronger means. After increasing his speed, the distance between him and Jiang Chen began to shorten once again.

“Not good. That late Heaven Immortal expert surely isn’t easy to deal with. They can manipulate the airflow skillfully. Their speed definitely is incomparable to those early Heaven Immortals. Although I can move in quick speed, my cultivation base is still too weak. That bastard behind me has already locked on my Qi. At this rate, I won’t be able to escape from him. It’s going to be bad for us.”

Jiang Chen’s facial expression turned slightly ugly. With his current state, if he was tangled with the high-level expert of Profound Sun Sect, that expert surely wouldn’t let him go until he died. This wouldn’t do him any good at all. Thus, he needed to find a way to escape.
“What do we do now?”
Asked Han Yan. If Jiang Chen didn’t have a solution for this, Han Yan would be worse than him. All he could do now was to stay in the Ancestral Dragon Pagoda like an obedient kid.
As Jiang Chen was flying, his mind was racing for solution. Soon, his eyes lit up. He shifted his attention to the Ancestral Dragon Pagoda.

Ancestral Dragon Pagoda is a very valuable treasure of the dragon race, a supreme divine treasure that even the Immortal World’s law can’t control it. I suspect that those Heaven Immortals won’t be able to feel the Ancestral Dragon Pagoda’s existence as well. I will now fuse my bloodline and Qi with the pagoda, fully concealing my existence with it.

Muttered Jiang Chen in his heart. Although there were twelve levels in the pagoda, there was still a long way before reaching its peak - 99 levels, but Jiang Chen was incomparably confident in his pagoda. One should know that the Ancestral Dragon Pagoda could even stay unaffected in the Immortal World. In other words, such a divine weapon must possessed some very powerful origin. Thus, there shouldn’t be a problem of using it to conceal himself.
When his thought reached here, he turned and plunged into the pagoda. Then it turned into a tiny dust and drifted in the air.
Shortly after hiding in the pagoda, Elder Xie emerged at the scene where Jiang Chen was at. He stopped in his tracks when he discovered that Jiang Chen’s Qi has disappeared all of a sudden.
“How did he vanish all of a sudden? I have already locked on his Qi. He shouldn’t be able to escape from me. Could he be using some kind of means to conceal himself?”

Elder Xie knitted his brows tightly. This is the first time that such a strange thing happened to him, but he didn’t believe that an Earth Immortal could disappeared under his eyes unnoticeably, it would be ironic if he thought so.
*Hu Hu...*

Elder Xie unleashed his divine sense and swept across the surrounding void thoroughly without missing a single thing. He believed that the person must have used some kind of camouflage technique which he thought wouldn’t work on him. The moment he found that person, he would surely tear that person to pieces. He would let the person know how tragic the consequences were to offend the Profound Sun Sect.

His divine sense swept through every place like blades, causing a rustling sound in the void. Elder Xie’s divine sense covered a very large area and it was very dense. Not even a fly could escape from his perception a few dozen miles away.

When his divine sense passed through the Ancestral Dragon Pagoda, he discovered nothing unusual. Every place his divine sense went was empty and no cultivator’s Qi was found. After searching for roughly 15 minutes, he lost his patience and almost spurted out blood.
“Dammit! It’s an evil technique. Could this bastard even ascend to become God?”

Elder Xie was infuriated. He had never encountered this kind of situation before. Jiang Chen’s unnoticeable disappearance was too absurd, as if he was never here. He finally understood what the feeling of being powerless and helpless was.
“Little Chen, what kind of treasure is this? It’s so powerful. Not even Heaven Immortal expert can sense it.”

In the Ancestral Dragon Pagoda, Han Yan said, feeling surprised. There was no way that he wouldn’t be surprised. He could clearly feel Elder Xie’s divine sense passing over the pagoda just now, but this old man didn’t even sense the least bit of their Qi. The elder’s incompetence couldn’t be explained through this. It was the divinity of the Ancestral Dragon Pagoda.

“This Ancestral Dragon Pagoda is a supreme divine weapon. I have condensed it using my dragon transformation art. But it is still far from completion. I was also astonished by its’ divinity before. If I’m not mistaken, only those Immortal King experts who had fully mastered the spatial law could find me hiding in this pagoda.

Said Jiang Chen. What he saw from Elder Xie made him even more confident in the pagoda. It would be impossible for any ordinary divine sense to find the pagoda’s existence as it could fully integrate with the spatial law. He was sure that any expert below the Immortal King wouldn’t be able to locate such a weapon.
“What the hell? So cool? Does that mean that as long as the pagoda is here, we will be invincible in One-Line-Sky?”
Han Yan widened his eyes and stared at Jiang Chen in disbelief.

“That’s not entirely true. My pagoda has only twelve floors. If the trace of our activity was too obvious, the powerful Great Luo Golden Immortal expert would still be able to find some clue. Besides, there are half-step Immortal King experts in One-Line-Sky. Although these experts have yet to fully master the spatial law, they can also be a very dangerous threat to us as they already have half of the mastery.”
Said Jiang Chen. At least with this divine pagoda, he wouldn’t worry of being killed by any Heaven and Divine Immortal experts. This would be his greatest trump card and amulet.
“That’s still very terrifying though. Look at that old man. He has already made a dozen of circles here. Haha!”
Han Yan laughed loudly. Elder Xie had been going around in circle in the area, but still found no clue about Jiang Chen’s movement.
“Son of a b*tch!”

Elder Xie swore abruptly. Being in such a situation, even a very courteous person would lose its patience. The elder came to catch the enemy for destroying the ore mine and killing his people, but now, he couldn’t even find a hair of his target.
Eventually, Elder Xie had no other choice. He could only return with dissatisfaction and failure.
“That old man is gone. We can go out now.” Said Han Yan.
“Don’t be hasty. This is an old cunning fox. He won’t let this go so easily.”
Said Jiang Chen. The two of them continued to stay in the pagoda for another dozen of minutes. Sure enough, the elder returned and made another circle before he really left for good.
Looking at the situation, Han Yan had to give a thumbs up to Jiang Chen. This was wisdom and experience. If that old man was an old fox, Jiang Chen would be a wise fox.
“Well, here we go.”
Jiang Chen smiled, came out of the pagoda together with Han Yan. Then, he vanished into the darkness along with Han Yan.

Jiang Chen had just arrived in One-Line-Sky, so he still hadn’t found a place to reside. After leaving the zone that was in Profound Sun Sect’s control, they decided to head towards the direction where the Skycloud Pavilion was located.

Except for gaining an advantage in that battle, Jiang Chen normally wouldn’t use flying to travel. Also, it wouldn’t do Han Yan any good by bringing him through the air. Han Yan needed time to break through the higher realm. So he needed to practice on his own instead of depending on an external force in travelling.

After a day and night of running, they finally reached the edge of a city in third day’s morning. Han Yan had been cultivating along the way. Not only was his injuries had fully recovered, his cultivation base had also improved by leaps and bounds, advancing to the late Human Immortal realm. Because of the help of the Ancient Divine Devil bloodline, his improvement couldn’t be describe with rationality. Plus, his current state had been stable. At this rate, it would take him roughly a few days’ time to reach the peak of late Human Immortal realm, leaving him only a step away from the half-step Earth Immortal realm.
Apart from his cultivation base, he also had a very powerful combat strength. Now not even ordinary half-step Earth Immortal expert was a match for him.
“Ah Yan, you improve very fast.”
Jiang Chen smiled after noticing Han Yan’s improvement.
“That’s of course, I possess the body of the Divine Devil. It will be a humiliation to my bloodline if my advancement is too slow.”
Han Yan chuckled. His present mood was a lot better than a few days ago.
“In front should be the territory of Skycloud Pavilion and there’s a city ahead. Let’s go over and have a look to check out the latest information.”
Said Jiang Chen. He felt that he was getting a step closer to his objective after arriving here.

chapters.title: Chapter 1115 - The Eight Immortals of One-Line-Sky
paragraphs: 6/14 chapters!
Cloudmist City!

Seeing it from a distance, this towering city was shrouded in fog and it looked like a fairyland. Cloudmist City could be regarded as the barrier of Skycloud Pavilion. Once one arrived in Cloudmist City, one had truly entered the territory of Skycloud Pavilion. Whether it was in the aspect of its scale or its imposing manner, Cloudmist City could throw Yan City to the bottom of the comparison list.

In the Immortal World, every city would have their own major power. There was no exception to Cloudmist City and Yan City. Anyone who entered Cloudmist City must pay a tax - one low grade Immortal Meta Stone. It was the condition before one could step into the city.

To any ordinary expert, especially Earth Immortal experts, one low grade Immortal Meta Stone wasn’t anything significant, but due to many people coming and going out of the city, the tax had become a hefty sum of income for the city. In other words, whoever had the control of the city had control over its wealth.

Jiang Chen and Han Yan paid two low grade Immortal Meta Stones and were granted permission to enter the internal part of the city. They were wealthy people now. There was nothing much to talk about Jiang Chen after he received the inheritance of Ouyang He. His fortune would dominate lots of things. Han Yan on the other hand had also become wealthy. Most of the Immortal Meta Stones seized from the ore mine was kept in his bag of holding.
“Do you all know about this? It seems like something has happened to Profound Sun Sect.”

“Of course. Someone has raided a stronghold of theirs at night, killed more than a dozen outer sect disciples, robbed a large amount of Immortal Meta Stones and destroyed the ore mine. That man is too audacious. I think his name is called Jiang Chen. Profound Sun Sect has already given the order to kill. Anyone who can capture him or provide information about him, will be rewarded by the sect handsomely.”

“It isn’t as easy as it sounds. I heard that not even the elder of the inner sect, Elder Xie could catch up to this Jiang Chen. That man is too mystical. The news said that this man was only an early Earth Immortal expert, but he had a Forbidden Technique that allowed him to transform and tremendously enhance his combat power.”

“He’s very powerful, and audacious enough to have the nerve to even kill the people of Profound Sun Sect and destroy their ore mine, causing them to suffer a heavy loss. They will never let this matter go for sure, even the order to kill was issued. It only showed how much the Profound Sun Sect wanted Jiang Chen dead now.”

“Having the power to fight against Heaven Immortal while merely being an Earth Immortal, and he was also able to escape from a late Heaven Immortal expert’s pursuit? I have never heard of such a monstrous genius before. None of us have. When has such a figure emerged in One-Line-Sky?”

As soon as they entered the city, their ears were filled with these news. Every place was discussing things about him. It seems like the commotion Jiang Chen made the day before yesterday wasn’t a small one. It had caused a stir in the whole One-Line-Sky.
“Little Chen, it seems like you have become famous again.”
Han Yan said with a light chuckle. This was Jiang Chen. Wherever he went, he would always get all of the attention.
“The news spreads faster than I expected. It seems like Profound Sun Sect is truly infuriated this time. However, this is also fine as this is what I wanted.”

Jiang Chen revealed a slight smile at the corner of his mouth. The news of Profound Sun Sect issuing the order to kill had spread across the whole One-Line-Sky with the fastest speed. In this way, Jiang Chen’s name would be spread to everyone as well, and the people of Skycloud Pavilion would certainly notice his conduct.
“I heard that Skycloud Pavilion has shifted its attention to Jiang Chen. Someone is surely going to recruit this genius to join the pavilion.”

“I also heard that the Young Master of Cloudmist City, Fu Hui has already declared to befriend Jiang Chen. He is an inner sect disciple of Skycloud Pavilion. His cultivation has already reached a terrifying extent, intermediate Heaven Immortal realm.”

“That’s a normal thing. Skycloud Pavilion and Profound Sun Sect are both enemies to each other. Jiang Chen has caused the Profound Sun Sect to suffer a tragic loss, which is worth celebrating to the Skycloud Pavilion. Naturally, they will welcome an unusual genius like Jiang Chen. Therefore, it isn’t a surprising thing at all for Young Master Fu Hui to befriend Jiang Chen.”
“Tomorrow is the birthday of the City Lord. I suppose that Young Master Fu Hui is already in Cloudmist City now.”
The noise of discussion was non-stop. All these news had been absorbed by Jiang Chen’s ears. The smile on his face intensified.

“Little Chen, it seems like everything that happened was just as you expected. Skycloud Pavilion is starting to notice you. I wonder if you can make friends with that Young Master Fu Hui?” Said Han Yan.
“Don’t worry. I will reach my goal in no time.”

Jiang Chen had a composed face. Regardless of what time it was, his face always looked calm. Everything was under his control from the moment he raided the ore mine of Profound Sun Sect. The emergence of Fu Hui was just a springboard for him to get closer to Skycloud Pavilion.
“Ah Yan, let’s go over to that tavern in front and have some drinks. Perhaps we can learn more about the news of One-Line-Sky by eaves dropping on other people’s conversation.”

Said Jiang Chen. The two of them walked towards the tavern that was not far ahead. Both of them had just made it to the Immortal World and knew nothing about One-Line-Sky. Now that they had arrived at CloudmistCity, they could hear all kinds of news. Wherever there were people, there would be conversations and gossips about any big event that happened in One-Line-Sky.
In the tavern, both of them chose the seat beside a window and ordered two pots of Immortal World’s wine. They listened to the others’ gossip while enjoying the liquor.
Unsurprisingly, much of the gossip was related to him. They could hear things about Jiang Chen and the Profound Sun Sect from time to time.

“Right, there’s another big event that is going to happen in One-Line-Sky. It is a grand ceremony of One-Line-Sky. At that time, all the eight Immortals of One-Line-Sky will be present. This is a biannual big event.”

“Yes. How can I forget about this big event, the grand ceremony that is held once every two years? The Eight Immortals will converge on the Peak of One-Line-Sky Mountain for a competition to determine the strongest amongst them. Unfortunately, after so many years of holding this ceremony, neither victory nor defeat could be determined.”

“Unfortunately, the pavilion master, Ouyang He has already fallen two years ago, resulting in the loss of one Immortal amongst the Eight. Then, the vacancy was filled by the disciple of Ouyang He, Tian Muyun. He has also become the new pavilion master. I wonder if he possesses the same momentum as Ouyang He.”

“He shouldn’t be as bad. Tian Muyun is a legendary figure in One-Line-Sky. He has outgrown his own master and his cultivation is no longer under Ouyang He’s. Under his leadership, Skycloud Pavilion has been thriving just like before.”

The news about the Eight Immortals shook Jiang Chen’s soul. This was new to him. He had no idea what the Eight Immortals were like, but judging from those people’s respectful tone, these figure must be extraordinary.
Jiang Chen stood up from his seat, came to another table with three seats already occupied by three men. He found an empty seat and straightaway sat on it.
“Three brothers, this bill is on little brother today.” Said Jiang Chen in a forthright manner.

After hearing what Jiang Chen said, the three of them changed their view of Jiang Chen immediately. Every one of them was a rogue cultivator. They liked anyone who was forthright. Plus, this tavern was very popular here and not everyone could come in here. They would naturally be delighted if they were treated to a few drinks.
“Little brother is?” One man asked.

“Little brother has just arrived in One-Line-Sky and is unfamiliar with everything around here. I just heard three brothers talked about the One-Line Sky’s Eight Immortals and some grand ceremony, and I became very interested with the subject. I wonder who those Eight Immortals were that brothers are talking about.” Asked Jiang Chen.

“Haha! Little Brother doesn’t even know about the One-Line Sky’s Eight Immortals? It seems like you really have just arrived in One-Line-Sky. In that case, old brother will tell you more about these Eight Immortals.”
One of them burst out into laughter. The One-Line Sky’s Eight Immortals wasn’t a secret and everyone was free to discuss about it.

“There are four major powers in One-Line-Sky. They are Skycloud Pavilion, Profound Sun Sect, Huangfu Family and Yun Family. The One-Line Sky’s Eight Immortals are the peak experts among the four major powers. There are two peak experts for every major power. The average cultivation of theirs has already reached the half-step Immortal King realm. They are Tian Muyun and Daoist Yufeng of Skycloud Pavilion, Xuan Yangyi and Dugu Sheng from Profound Sun Sect, Huangfu Yaotian and Huangfu Qun of Huangfu Family and Yun Zhonghe and Yun Zhonglong of Yun Family. Cloudmist City!
Seeing it from a distance, this towering city was shrouded in fog and it looked like a fairyland.
Cloudmist City could be regarded as the barrier of Skycloud Pavilion.
Once one arrived in Cloudmist City, one had truly entered the territory of Skycloud Pavilion.
Whether it was in the aspect of its scale or its imposing manner, Cloudmist City could throw Yan City to the bottom of the comparison list.
In the Immortal World, every city would have their own major power.
There was no exception to Cloudmist City and Yan City.
Anyone who entered Cloudmist City must pay a tax - one low grade Immortal Meta Stone.
It was the condition before one could step into the city.

To any ordinary expert, especially Earth Immortal experts, one low grade Immortal Meta Stone wasn’t anything significant, but due to many people coming and going out of the city, the tax had become a hefty sum of income for the city.
In other words, whoever had the control of the city had control over its wealth.
Jiang Chen and Han Yan paid two low grade Immortal Meta Stones and were granted permission to enter the internal part of the city.
They were wealthy people now.
There was nothing much to talk about Jiang Chen after he received the inheritance of Ouyang He.
His fortune would dominate lots of things.
Han Yan on the other hand had also become wealthy.
Most of the Immortal Meta Stones seized from the ore mine was kept in his bag of holding.
“Do you all know about this?
It seems like something has happened to Profound Sun Sect.”
“Of course.
Someone has raided a stronghold of theirs at night, killed more than a dozen outer sect disciples, robbed a large amount of Immortal Meta Stones and destroyed the ore mine.
That man is too audacious.
I think his name is called Jiang Chen.
Profound Sun Sect has already given the order to kill.
Anyone who can capture him or provide information about him, will be rewarded by the sect handsomely.”
“It isn’t as easy as it sounds.
I heard that not even the elder of the inner sect, Elder Xie could catch up to this Jiang Chen.
That man is too mystical.
The news said that this man was only an early Earth Immortal expert, but he had a Forbidden Technique that allowed him to transform and tremendously enhance his combat power.”
“He’s very powerful, and audacious enough to have the nerve to even kill the people of Profound Sun Sect and destroy their ore mine, causing them to suffer a heavy loss.
They will never let this matter go for sure, even the order to kill was issued.
It only showed how much the Profound Sun Sect wanted Jiang Chen dead now.”
“Having the power to fight against Heaven Immortal while merely being an Earth Immortal, and he was also able to escape from a late Heaven Immortal expert’s pursuit?
I have never heard of such a monstrous genius before.
None of us have.
When has such a figure emerged in One-Line-Sky?”
As soon as they entered the city, their ears were filled with these news.
Every place was discussing things about him.
It seems like the commotion Jiang Chen made the day before yesterday wasn’t a small one.
It had caused a stir in the whole One-Line-Sky.
“Little Chen, it seems like you have become famous again.”
Han Yan said with a light chuckle.
This was Jiang Chen.
Wherever he went, he would always get all of the attention.
“The news spreads faster than I expected.
It seems like Profound Sun Sect is truly infuriated this time.
However, this is also fine as this is what I wanted.”
Jiang Chen revealed a slight smile at the corner of his mouth.
The news of Profound Sun Sect issuing the order to kill had spread across the whole One-Line-Sky with the fastest speed.
In this way, Jiang Chen’s name would be spread to everyone as well, and the people of Skycloud Pavilion would certainly notice his conduct.
“I heard that Skycloud Pavilion has shifted its attention to Jiang Chen.
Someone is surely going to recruit this genius to join the pavilion.”
“I also heard that the Young Master of Cloudmist City, Fu Hui has already declared to befriend Jiang Chen.
He is an inner sect disciple of Skycloud Pavilion.
His cultivation has already reached a terrifying extent, intermediate Heaven Immortal realm.”
“That’s a normal thing.
Skycloud Pavilion and Profound Sun Sect are both enemies to each other.
Jiang Chen has caused the Profound Sun Sect to suffer a tragic loss, which is worth celebrating to the Skycloud Pavilion.
Naturally, they will welcome an unusual genius like Jiang Chen.
Therefore, it isn’t a surprising thing at all for Young Master Fu Hui to befriend Jiang Chen.”
“Tomorrow is the birthday of the City Lord.
I suppose that Young Master Fu Hui is already in Cloudmist City now.”
The noise of discussion was non-stop.
All these news had been absorbed by Jiang Chen’s ears.
The smile on his face intensified.
“Little Chen, it seems like everything that happened was just as you expected.
Skycloud Pavilion is starting to notice you.
I wonder if you can make friends with that Young Master Fu Hui?” Said Han Yan.
“Don’t worry.
I will reach my goal in no time.”
Jiang Chen had a composed face.
Regardless of what time it was, his face always looked calm.
Everything was under his control from the moment he raided the ore mine of Profound Sun Sect.
The emergence of Fu Hui was just a springboard for him to get closer to Skycloud Pavilion.
“Ah Yan, let’s go over to that tavern in front and have some drinks.
Perhaps we can learn more about the news of One-Line-Sky by eaves dropping on other people’s conversation.”
Said Jiang Chen.

Both of them had just made it to the Immortal World and knew nothing about One-Line-Sky.
Now that they had arrived at CloudmistCity, they could hear all kinds of news.
Wherever there were people, there would be conversations and gossips about any big event that happened in One-Line-Sky.
In the tavern, both of them chose the seat beside a window and ordered two pots of Immortal World’s wine.
They listened to the others’ gossip while enjoying the liquor.
Unsurprisingly, much of the gossip was related to him.
They could hear things about Jiang Chen and the Profound Sun Sect from time to time.
“Right, there’s another big event that is going to happen in One-Line-Sky.
It is a grand ceremony of One-Line-Sky.
At that time, all the eight Immortals of One-Line-Sky will be present.
This is a biannual big event.”
“Yes.
How can I forget about this big event, the grand ceremony that is held once every two years?
The Eight Immortals will converge on the Peak of One-Line-Sky Mountain for a competition to determine the strongest amongst them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1116 - The Dog that Courted Hate
paragraphs: 7/14 chapters!

Ouyang He’s unfinished matter had been Jiang Chen’s worry ever since. The only way to get rid of this concern was to eliminate Tian Muyun, so that Ouyang He could rest in peace in the world of the dead. Besides, it made Jiang Chen feel unworthy and aggrieved for Ouyang He after learning how popular Tian Muyun had become and how he had been treated like a legend.
However, the only way to get close to Tian Muyun was to enter the Skycloud Pavilion. In front of him was the best springboard that he could ever have, Fu Hai, the Young Master of Cloudmist City.

Jiang Chen and Han Yan walked all the way to the Prefecture. Due to the large size of the city, they were afraid that would take them at least two hours to reach their destination at such a slow pace, but time wasn’t Jiang Chen’s concern anyway.

In the Cloudmist City, he didn’t need to worry about Profound Sun Sect taking revenge on him. Although the Profound Sun Sect had a very big influence in One-Line-Sky and there had been disciples of Profound Sun Sect in Cloudmist City, they wouldn’t dare act brazenly and arrogantly. After all, this was a hostile territory to them. A slight mistake could cost them their life.

The closer Jiang Chen and Han Yan got to the Prefecture, the denser the crowd. It seemed like they were heading for the Prefecture as well. When they reached the end, they saw some cultivators began to jog towards their destination, as if something big had happened there.

Jiang Chen and Han Yan couldn’t help but be stunned. It seemed like not only had they obtained enormous amount of information in their first day of arrival in Cloudmists City, they could also watch some lively show.
“Could it be something big has happened in the Prefecture? We have to catch up with them at the right time.” Said Han Yan with curiosity.
“Let’s go over there and find out.”
Jiang Chen strode forth with a quickened pace. He approached a running cultivator and asked. “Brother, do you know what is happening in front?”
“I have no idea. When I see the others running towards the Prefecture, I just followed them.”
That cultivator said solemnly.

Both Jiang Chen and Han Yan were shocked. Such reason gave them no room to retort, because they were like those cultivators who knew nothing about it. They were just following the crowd, expecting to watch a show.

The Prefecture of Cloudmist City had the roughly the same scale as the Prefecture in Yan City. Similarly, in front of the gates was a large open square. Currently, this square had been occupied with a sea of people. Everyone’s attention was focused on the high platform at the center. Then they saw a big yellow dog the size of an elephant being tied up like loops of golden iron chain.

Beside the big yellow dog stood four powerful experts. Every one of them were early Heaven Immortal expert. Their hands were holding large sabre, seemingly ready to chop off the dog’s head at any time.
The crowd below pointed their fingers at the big yellow dog and were gossiping about him.
“For Heaven’s sake! What are you looking at? Is Master Dog really so handsome?”

The big yellow dog was baring his sharp teeth at the crowd. Although he had already been tied up pretty badly and his head was aimed by the four big sabers that could end his life instantly, his face didn’t have the slightest bit of nervousness, like all these sharp sabers were harmless to him.
“Damn! Where has this mangy dog came from? He still dares to act so arrogantly in the face of death.”
“That’s right. This dog is too abhorrent. He dares to steal even the things of the Prefecture.”
“This dog has offended Young Master Fu Hui. It seems like he is going to be executed by means of Ling Chi* today.”
Discussions were all over the place. These cultivators must have lots of leisure time to just come and watch a dog being executed.
At this time, Jiang Chen and Han Yan had already reached the scene. When they saw the big yellow dog being bundled up like a dumpling, both of them staggered backwards, and almost fell to the ground.
The two of them exchanged a glance. It went without saying that this dog had either eaten or stolen some people’s things. It was all because of this dog that the Prefecture was so bustling today.

If Jiang Chen was described as the man who brought no peace to anywhere he went, Big Yellow was worse than that. He would never be Big Yellow if he didn’t create a spotlight for himself with his conduct.
The both of them weaved into the crowd and saw a cultivator discussing about the current matter. It seemed like this man knew what was going on here.
“Brother, what has happened? Why is that dog over there tied up?” Asked Jiang Chen with a smile.
“Tied up? It’s going to be beheaded soon. This dog has eaten something in the Prefecture.” The man said.
Sure enough!
Jiang Chen and Han Yan couldn’t help but sigh. This had always been Big Yellow’s style of action.
“Brother, the Prefecture is such a big place and is short of nothing. Even if that something inside the Prefecture has been eaten by the dog, can’t they just put up with this dog once?” Said Han Yan.

“You know nothing about it. Tomorrow is the birthday of the City Lord. I heard that Young Master Fu Hui has paid a high price for the elder of Skycloud Pavilion to concoct a Transmogrification Pill. Not only could this pill lengthen one’s lifespan, it could also increase one’s strength. Young Master Fu Hui intended to give this pill as a birthday present for the City Lord, but he had never thought that it would be eaten by this dog yesterday night.”
The man seemed to know exactly what had happened.
“Dammit! I can’t believe that the highly precious Transmogrification Pill was eaten by a dog. This old man suddenly feels that a large part of my life is worse than a dog.”
“No wonder Young Master Fu Hui has been so angry. This dog had the nerve to even eat the birthday gift of the City Lord. Flaying it alive won’t be enough for its crime.”
“I have no idea where this dog came from? Look at it, it’s still baring its teeth at us even in the face of death, and seems like having a good time.”

Whatever Big Yellow did made Jiang Chen’s and Han Yan’s scalp tingle. This bastard really was a troublemaker. Jiang Chen intended to befriend Young Master Fu Hui in this trip to the Prefecture and get the chance to enter the Skycloud Pavilion. Presently, even if he hadn’t seen Young Master Fu Hui yet, his reputation would already be affected by this dog.
“Little Chen, look at Big Yellow’s face. Despite being tied up so badly, he doesn’t show the slightest bit of fear. I somehow felt that he let himself got caught on purpose.” Said Han Yan.

“Apparently, this stupid dog is doing this on purpose. Given his capability, if he’s able to steal away the pill, he’s also able to run away. However, he was captured in the end and stayed in their custody for three days. There is only one explanation for this, he didn’t intend to leave.”

Jiang Chen shook his head. Others might not understand Big Yellow, but he understood him very well. This dog was a very divine one. He was born with a Dragon-Horse bloodline. He was also an expert in stealing things and running away. If he really wanted to flee after stealing, not even Young Master Fu Hui could stop him.
Judging by the present situation, the only way to explain this was that Big Yellow hadn’t planned to leave in the first place.
“Brother, since this dog has been caught yesterday night, why hasn’t he been executed until today?”
Someone asked, feeling confused. If Young Master Fu Hui really wanted to kill a dog, he wouldn’t need to make such a fuss about it and attract so many people.

“You should know about that rising star Jiang Chen these past two days right? Initially, Young Master Fu Hui intended to end this dog’s life, but this dog claimed that he’s a friend of Jiang Chen. As long as he was here, Jiang Chen would surely appear. The idea has intrigued the Young Master, but he was afraid that this dog was telling lies, so he had ordered to tie it up tightly and gave him three days worth of time. If Jiang Chen didn’t appear in three days’ time, this dog would be executed without a doubt.” The man said.

After listening to this, it relieved Jiang Chen’s concern. It seemed like the things hadn’t reached an irreparable state yet. Since Young Master Fu Hui was so interested in him, it would be in his favor.
“Hey! Where did you get all this information from?” Someone asked.
“I have a cousin who works in the Prefecture. He was the one who told me. He is absolutely right about it.” The man said proudly.

“What you said sounds pretty convincing. Young Master Fu Hui always liked to make friends with heroes. Additionally, that Jiang Chen has become the arch enemy of Profound Sun Sect and had even given the order to kill him on sight. There’s no place in One-Line-Sky for him to stay anymore, which is the perfect time for Skycloud Pavilion to recruit him.”
“It’s still unknown whether this dog is telling the truth. Although we haven’t seen that Jiang Chen before, what he did was really earth-shattering. How can a genius like him befriend a mangy dog?”

For a moment, the topic had returned to Jiang Chen. The current situation had become clear. After Big Yellow stole the Transmogrification Pill of the Prefecture, he got himself caught on purpose to draw Jiang Chen out.
“Little Chen, it seems like everything is under Big Yellow’s control now. Has this bastard calculated that you will come to Cloudmist City?” Said Han Yan with a smile.

“This stupid dog knew me really well. He knows that after making the Profound Sun Sect my enemy, the first place that I would go to go to seek refuge was the territory of Profound Sun Sect’s enemy, the Skycloud Pavilion. Besides, Cloudmist City is the barrier of the territory of Skycloud Pavilion, a place that everyone needs to go through before reaching Skycloud Pavilion. That’s why he was being so unscrupulous.”
Jiang Chen shook his head with a smile. Big Yellow’s shrewdness wasn’t comparable to ordinary people.

As for Jiang Chen and Han Yan, it didn’t matter what Big Yellow did. What was more important was that the three of them had finally met, especially for Jiang Chen. Ever since they parted from the spatial passageway, concerns had been troubling his heart. After seeing how intact and energetic this dog was, he naturally couldn’t restrain himself from feeling happy.
“Shall we show ourselves now?” Han Yan asked.

“What are you panicking about? This stupid dog has eaten someone else’s thing, we have to let him suffer for a bit. We will come again three days later. Let him be tied here for three more days.” Jiang Chen chuckled.
“Yes.”
Han Yan nodded solemnly, then whirled with Jiang Chen and walked towards the outside of the crowd.
*Swoosh!*

At this moment, both of Big Yellow’s eyes lit up all of a sudden and fell upon Jiang Cheng and Han Yan who were drifting off the scene. Then, he clamored. “Jiang Chen, how dare you son of a b*tch turn and leave, letting master dog be tied up here?! Don’t you know what shame is?”
Big Yellow had keen a perception. He has already been on the lookout for Jiang Chen all the while. Now that Jiang Chen and Han Yan had appeared, it naturally couldn’t escape his eyes.
Ling Chi* - Death by a thousand cuts.

“Dammit!
I can’t believe that the highly precious Transmogrification Pill was eaten by a dog.
This old man suddenly feels that a large part of my life is worse than a dog.”
“No wonder Young Master Fu Hui has been so angry.
This dog had the nerve to even eat the birthday gift of the City Lord.
Flaying it alive won’t be enough for its crime.”
“I have no idea where this dog came from?
Look at it, it’s still baring its teeth at us even in the face of death, and seems like having a good time.”
Whatever Big Yellow did made Jiang Chen’s and Han Yan’s scalp tingle.
This bastard really was a troublemaker.
Jiang Chen intended to befriend Young Master Fu Hui in this trip to the Prefecture and get the chance to enter the Skycloud Pavilion.
Presently, even if he hadn’t seen Young Master Fu Hui yet, his reputation would already be affected by this dog.
“Little Chen, look at Big Yellow’s face.
Despite being tied up so badly, he doesn’t show the slightest bit of fear.
I somehow felt that he let himself got caught on purpose.” Said Han Yan.
“Apparently, this stupid dog is doing this on purpose.
Given his capability, if he’s able to steal away the pill, he’s also able to run away.
However, he was captured in the end and stayed in their custody for three days.
There is only one explanation for this, he didn’t intend to leave.”
Jiang Chen shook his head.
Others might not understand Big Yellow, but he understood him very well.
This dog was a very divine one.
He was born with a Dragon-Horse bloodline.
He was also an expert in stealing things and running away.
If he really wanted to flee after stealing, not even Young Master Fu Hui could stop him.
Judging by the present situation, the only way to explain this was that Big Yellow hadn’t planned to leave in the first place.
“Brother, since this dog has been caught yesterday night, why hasn’t he been executed until today?”
Someone asked, feeling confused.
If Young Master Fu Hui really wanted to kill a dog, he wouldn’t need to make such a fuss about it and attract so many people.
“You should know about that rising star Jiang Chen these past two days right?
Initially, Young Master Fu Hui intended to end this dog’s life, but this dog claimed that he’s a friend of Jiang Chen.
As long as he was here, Jiang Chen would surely appear.
The idea has intrigued the Young Master, but he was afraid that this dog was telling lies, so he had ordered to tie it up tightly and gave him three days worth of time.
If Jiang Chen didn’t appear in three days’ time, this dog would be executed without a doubt.” The man said.
After listening to this, it relieved Jiang Chen’s concern.
It seemed like the things hadn’t reached an irreparable state yet.
Since Young Master Fu Hui was so interested in him, it would be in his favor.
“Hey!
Where did you get all this information from?” Someone asked.
“I have a cousin who works in the Prefecture.
He was the one who told me.
He is absolutely right about it.” The man said proudly.
“What you said sounds pretty convincing.
Young Master Fu Hui always liked to make friends with heroes.
Additionally, that Jiang Chen has become the arch enemy of Profound Sun Sect and had even given the order to kill him on sight.
There’s no place in One-Line-Sky for him to stay anymore, which is the perfect time for Skycloud Pavilion to recruit him.”
“It’s still unknown whether this dog is telling the truth.
Although we haven’t seen that Jiang Chen before, what he did was really earth-shattering.
How can a genius like him befriend a mangy dog?”
For a moment, the topic had returned to Jiang Chen.
The current situation had become clear.
After Big Yellow stole the Transmogrification Pill of the Prefecture, he got himself caught on purpose to draw Jiang Chen out.
“Little Chen, it seems like everything is under Big Yellow’s control now.
Has this bastard calculated that you will come to Cloudmist City?” Said Han Yan with a smile.
“This stupid dog knew me really well.
He knows that after making the Profound Sun Sect my enemy, the first place that I would go to go to seek refuge was the territory of Profound Sun Sect’s enemy, the Skycloud Pavilion.
Besides, Cloudmist City is the barrier of the territory of Skycloud Pavilion, a place that everyone needs to go through before reaching Skycloud Pavilion.
That’s why he was being so unscrupulous.”
Jiang Chen shook his head with a smile.
Big Yellow’s shrewdness wasn’t comparable to ordinary people.
As for Jiang Chen and Han Yan, it didn’t matter what Big Yellow did.
What was more important was that the three of them had finally met, especially for Jiang Chen.
Ever since they parted from the spatial passageway, concerns had been troubling his heart.
After seeing how intact and energetic this dog was, he naturally couldn’t restrain himself from feeling happy.
“Shall we show ourselves now?” Han Yan asked.
“What are you panicking about?
This stupid dog has eaten someone else’s thing, we have to let him suffer for a bit.
We will come again three days later.
Let him be tied here for three more days.” Jiang Chen chuckled.
“Yes.”
Han Yan nodded solemnly, then whirled with Jiang Chen and walked towards the outside of the crowd.
*Swoosh!*
At this moment, both of Big Yellow’s eyes lit up all of a sudden and fell upon Jiang Cheng and Han Yan who were drifting off the scene.
Then, he clamored.
“Jiang Chen, how dare you son of a b*tch turn and leave, letting master dog be tied up here?!
Don’t you know what shame is?”
Big Yellow had keen a perception.
He has already been on the lookout for Jiang Chen all the while.
Now that Jiang Chen and Han Yan had appeared, it naturally couldn’t escape his eyes.
Ling Chi* - Death by a thousand cuts.

chapters.title: Chapter 1117 - Fu Hui
paragraphs: 8/14 chapters!
After being yelled by Big Yellow, everyone shifted their attention to Jiang Chen and Han Yan. Due to Jiang Chen’s name having risen to fame, it easily caught everyone’s attention.
“This stupid dog does have a keen perception for spotting us even in such a dense crowd.”
Han Yan shook his head helplessly.

Big Yellow who was tied up very tightly on the platform unleashed a surge of powerful force when he saw Jiang Cheng and Han Yan. The iron chains that were supposed to be indestructible were crushed like hemp ropes. The waves shook even the four experts who were armed with sabres.
Immediately, Big Yellow turned into a light and appeared before Jiang Chen and Han Yan with a swoosh.

This scene shocked many people, especially the four Heaven Immortal experts who had been besieging Big Yellow. It seemed like they couldn’t stop this dog if it insisted to leave; they had totally underestimated this dog. “What the hell! This dog is actually this powerful? He broke free from the four Heaven Immortals!”
“That’s right. It seems like we’ve all underestimated this dog. He had deceived us by getting himself tied up willingly.”

“So what if he’s very powerful? This is the Prefecture. If Young Master Fu Hui is determined to get rid of him, he won’t have a chance of escaping at all. As for that white-clothed youth, could he be the legendary Jiang Chen?”

Many of them were shocked. Big Yellow’s sudden burst of energy had exceeded everyone’s expectation. They were afraid that not even Young Master Fu Hui had thought that this dog would be this powerful.
“You two bastards! How could you turn and leave Master Dog here to suffer on his own? You two are truly shameless!”
Big Yellow bared his teeth at Jiang Chen and Han Yan while scolding them angrily. He was angry to learn that they didn’t only refused to help, but also had the intention to leave.

As a matter of fact, he had been searching for traces of Jiang Chen these past few days, but he hadn’t found a clue about him. He was restless and worried for his brother until yesterday, when he heard the news of Jiang Chen raiding the ore mine of Profound Sun Sect. After knowing that Fu Hui was interested in Jiang Chen, he directly broke into the Prefecture as he was sure that Jiang Chen would appear. He even ate the people’s pill and deliberately got himself caught. It was all fun and games for him.
Since Jiang Chen was very good at solving problems, he might as well create some problems for him to solve.
What really surprised him was Han Yan. He never thought of seeing Han Yan together with Jiang Chen here because he still thought that it should’ve taken a long time before Han Yan could ascend.

But then again, all of these no longer mattered. The important thing was that they were reunited once more. Although he looked infuriated right now, he felt quite delighted in his heart, especially when he saw Jiang Chen. The bond between the two of them was incomprehensible to ordinary people. It was a bond that represented their life. At that time, at the end of the spatial passageway, Jiang Chen was attacked by some unknown expert. As a result, they were separated. He had been worrying for Jiang Chen all this while and was searching for him everywhere. Now that Jiang Chen was still intact in front of him, he couldn’t help but feel happy.
“You’ve eaten other people’s things. You deserve some punishment,” said Jiang Chen with a smile. Both he and Han Yan were happy.

After checking Big Yellow’s cultivation, Jiang Chen’s eyes sparkled with delight. He had to admit that Big Yellow really was the most extraordinary one. Although he had no idea what had Big Yellow experienced during these past few days, Big Yellow’s cultivation base was even higher than his—late Earth Immortal realm.
*Swoosh!* *Swoosh!* *Swoosh!*

At this time, the four Heaven Immortal experts flew over, besieging Big Yellow, Jiang Chen and Han Yan. The orders they got from Young Master Fu Hui was to contain this yellow dog. They couldn’t afford to bear the responsibility of letting this huge yellow dog escape under their vey nose.
“Quickly go and tell your Young Master that the one he was looking for is here. He’s no doubt the widely known Jiang Chen,” said Big Yellow proudly.
As soon as his voice faded, the crowd turned shocked. At this instant, Jiang Chen turned into a focal figure. Countless pairs of eyes fell upon him at the same time.

“My God! It turns out that he is Jiang Chen. He really is young, but he was able to cause so much of damage to Profound Sun Sect despite being only an early Earth Immortal expert. He is really the most monstrous genius I’ve ever seen. Plus, his audacity is beyond ordinary. He is the first man throughout One-Line-Sky who dared to do such a thing.”
“Ever since Profound Sun Sect issued the order to kill, this Jiang Chen has risen to fame. I never thought of seeing his true appearance today.”
“He’s too young, a real genius. It would really be a good thing if Skycloud Pavilion could get this talent.”
“Can’t believe that this stupid dog is a friend of Jiang Chen. Fortunately, Jiang Chen is here, otherwise, Young Master Fu Hui would flay this dog to death.”

Comments and remarks filled the air and Jiang Chen had become the centre of attention. Anyone knew that Jiang Chen’s reputation had already spread across the entire One-Line-Sky like a gale the moment Profound Sun Sect issued the order to kill. Even this city was filled with gossips and topics about Jiang Chen. Naturally, it was a big thing to be able to see Jiang Chen’s true self here.
“You are Jiang Chen?”
One of the experts looked at Jiang Chen in disbelief.
“Yes, that’s me.”

Jiang Chen nodded. By now, he didn’t have to hide it anymore. This was the Prefecture. Even if some people of Profound Sun Sect were here, they wouldn’t dare to act according to the order unless they wanted to get themselves killed.
“You wait here.”
The man said, turned and raced towards the Prefecture.

Jiang Chen knew that that man must be going into the Prefecture to inform Young Master Fu Hui. Coincidentally, his purpose of coming here was also to meet Young Master Fu Hui. Although Big Yellow had created a grudge between them, it had also indirectly helped him and Young Master Fu Hui have a meeting.

Shortly after that, two figures walked out of the Prefecture. One of them was the expert who had raced into the Prefecture. The other was a man dressed in pale-yellow robe. He was stately, handsome, had bushy brows and big eyes. He might not seem very tall or strong, but he wasn’t thin either. He looked like a sturdy person.
Every step he made was imposing. The whole scene became quiet the moment he appeared. The people automatically made way for him as he passed. Innumerable pair of eyes fell upon him with awe.

He was Young Master Fu Hui, an inner sect disciple in Skycloud Pavilion. Perhaps that didn’t make him any significant in Skycloud Pavilion, but in Cloudmist City, he was without a doubt a legendary existence. He had already reached mid Heaven Immortal realm at such a young age. A talent like this wasn’t comparable to any average person.
Both Jiang Chen’s and Fu Hui’s eyes met when they looked up.
Fu Hui approached Jiang Chen and studied him thoroughly.

“You were the Jiang Chen who killed more than a dozen outer sect disciples of Profound Sun Sect, destroyed their ore mine and successfully escaped from the hunt of a late Heaven Immortal elder?” asked Fu Hui.

Shock was visible in his eyes. Apparently, this Jiang Chen wasn’t similar to the Jiang Chen he imagined. This white-clothed youth seemed like a bright and approachable boy with no ferocity and ruthlessness. It was hard for anyone to believe that this young man could do such an earth-shattering matter.
“I’m Jiang Chen, greet Young Master Fu Hui.”

Jiang Chen cupped his fists at Fu Hui. Without waiting for Fu Hui to speak, he continued, “Big Yellow is my brother. We were separated not long ago. I heard that he has eaten Young Master’s Transmogrification Pill. Here’s a million low grade Immortal Meta Stones as compensation,” said Jiang Chen and handed over a storage pouch to Fu Hui.

Fu Hui was dumbfounded when he saw this. He had never expected Jiang Chen to be so heroic, quickly smoothing out the matter of Big Yellow stealing the pill. Furthermore, one million low grade Immortal Meta Stones was a tremendous wealth, definitely exceeding the value of the Transmogrification Pill. Even he himself was rendered speechless.

Moreover, Fu Hui intended to befriend Jiang Chen and recruit him into Skycloud Pavilion. In their first meeting, he was already astounded by Jiang Chen’s action. In other words, his impression of Jiang Chen was a pleasant one.

“Damn! This Jiang Chen is truly rich, giving one million worth of fortune. Although the Transmogrification Pill is precious, one million low grade Immortal Meta Stones are more than enough to compensate for one pill. In this way, the Prefecture wouldn’t suffer any losses.”

“Of course, he’s a rich guy. Don’t forget that he has raided an ore mine of Profound Sun Sect. Although that ore mine hadn’t been fully mined, the mining had already started there and an astronomical amount of fortune had already been mined out before the raid.”
“Rich people are always self-willed. He gives out one million of his fortune so easily like it is nothing to him and he did not even blink when he said that.”
The people around were gossiping amongst each other. Even though those were only low grade Immortal Meta Stones, one million wasn’t a small figure.
“Kaka! Young Master Fu Hui, although Master Dog has eaten your pill, I suppose this one million should be enough for that.”
Big Yellow laughed, not forgetting to dart a praising glance at Jiang Chen.

“Alright, Brother Jiang sure is a heroic person. I, Fu Hui, always like to make friends with people like you. I will keep this one million worth of fortune and the matter of Big Yellow’s theft is settled today. I wonder if Brother Jiang wants to come to our Prefecture and have a seat there.”
Young Master Fu Hui didn’t try to be overly polite. After keeping the Immortal Meta Stones, he invited Jiang Chen to the Prefecture.
“Okay.”

Jiang Chen nodded. This was exactly the result he wanted in their first meeting, but this was better than what he expected. The reason he took out one million worth of fortune was to defuse the tension between Big Yellow and this young master. At the same time, he wanted to return the dignity to Fu Hui. The theft of the pill had been spread across the city. If this matter wasn’t solved nicely, Fu Hui would lose his face.
Additionally, one million worth of fortune wasn’t anything significant to a wealthy man like him.
